description: Conventions and skills for TypeScript HTTP API development with vitest + msw.
author: example

rules.rule: When adding endpoints, always write a vitest spec under tests/ that uses msw for HTTP mocking.
rules.rationale: Detected across 7 sessions where the user explicitly redirected toward msw and away from manual fetch stubs.

rules.rule: When fixing errors, identify the error type before adding handlers; do not wrap unrelated code in try/catch.
rules.rationale: User corrected over-broad try/catch in 5 sessions.

rules.rule: Before suggesting a refactor is done, run the typecheck script and report any new errors.

skills.title: Scaffold a new HTTP endpoint
skills.description: Five-step workflow to add a typed HTTP endpoint with handler, route registration, schema, and test.
skills.content:
---
name: api-endpoint-scaffold
description: Add a typed HTTP endpoint with handler, schema, route, and test.
---

## When to use

The user asks to add a new endpoint, route, or HTTP handler.

## Steps

1. Locate the route registration file.
2. Add the handler function with typed request/response.
3. Add the zod schema for the request body.
4. Register the route.
5. Add a vitest spec using msw.
